decisions.reason: The formwork profile system sits at the core of the firm's established offer and has a page of its own, so investment and visible commitment favor keeping it despite only one year on the market.
The automated distributor flow control embodies the firm's announced push into automation, so any weak early results would be read as temporary and the firm would persist.

The shuttering magnet block is a low-cost addition to the magnetic formwork range that fits the established portfolio, though it is only mentioned on the website and so carries less visible commitment.
The magnetic formwork strips are central to the formwork line and prominently presented on their own page, which publicly commits the firm to continuing them.
